WOODWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
